title: From RLVR to RLSVR: Task Transformation Induces Self-Verifiable Rewards for Open-Ended LLM Self-Improvement
task: Extend RLVR to open-ended tasks via task transformation
key_results: SpyRL outperforms existing self-improvement methods on text summarization, creative writing, and mathematical reasoning; verifiable rewards generated through multi-agent self-play voting
comments: Clever approach converting open-ended tasks into verifiable proxy environments, though the connection between spy identification and output quality remains somewhat indirect.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Task transformation can extend RLVR beyond inherently verifiable domains
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SpyRL achieves consistent gains on both verifiable and non-verifiable tasks

title: N_0-VTLA: Scaling Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Model with Latent Tactile Tokens
task: Contact-rich manipulation with tactile perception and offline policy improvement
key_results: Wins all 9 NeoReal real-robot tasks; 63.8% mean success on 20-task simulation (vs 44.0% baseline); 75-95% success on long-horizon real-robot tasks with ALTER
comments: First VTLA model pre-trained on large-scale tactile data; the asymmetric Mixture-of-Transformers architecture balances efficiency with predictive capacity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Large-scale visuo-tactile pre-training improves contact-rich manipulation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; N_0-VTLA outperforms strong baselines by wide margins across benchmarks

title: Meshy T2: Fast Native Mesh Generation with Flow Matching
task: Fast native mesh generation from images
key_results: Median 6 seconds end-to-end image-to-mesh (10x faster than autoregressive baselines); state-of-the-art geometric fidelity; supports multi-part assets and vertex-budget control
comments: Flow matching architecture elegantly addresses mesh generation as coarse-to-fine process; native handling of connectivity without quantization is a practical advantage.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Flow matching enables faster parallel mesh generation than autoregressive decoding
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; coarse-to-fine flow-based design achieves interactive generation speed

title: Mental World Modeling
task: Predict human decisions by modeling mental state alongside physical world
key_results: MENTIS training-free baseline demonstrates mental-state modeling is essential; explicit mental variables outperform physical-only models on situated decision scenarios
comments: Conceptually strong framework elevating mental state from post-hoc rationalization to core component, but evaluation remains on constructed datasets rather than deployed systems.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit mental-state modeling is essential for predicting human decisions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; mental variables outperform physical-only baselines across text, image, video modalities

title: AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications
task: Audit system prompts in commercial AI products for user-centric dimensions
key_results: Reviewed 3,249 instructions from 88 products; 98.9% contain protective instructions but only 24% cover all 8 AISPA dimensions; ~40% contain problematic instructions despite protective ones present
comments: Important transparency work highlighting fragmentation in safety practices, though audit categorization relies on human judgment and may not capture subtle semantic nuances.

hypotheses.hypothesis: System prompt design lacks standardization and comprehensive user protection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; protective instructions shallow in scope and problematic instructions coexist across products

title: N_0-TWAM: Scaling Tactile-Native World-Action Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
task: Tactile-native world-action model for contact-rich manipulation with offline improvement
key_results: First tactile world-action model trained at scale; strong performance on contact-rich tasks; benefits demonstrated from data scaling for precise tactile/action prediction
comments: Complements N_0-VTLA with focus on predictive world modeling; asymmetric Mixture-of-Transformers addresses efficiency; tactile contact events enable multi-stage task staging.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Large-scale visuo-tactile data scaling improves tactile prediction and action generation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; benefits demonstrated across real and simulated contact-rich benchmarks

title: Scaling Properties of Text Conditioning in Visual Generation
task: Improve text-to-image generation via scaling properties of text conditioning
key_results: Converged diffusion loss scales linearly with structured language (GPG metric) and follows power law with attribute metric (ED); system outperforms open-weight models on compositional/reasoning benchmarks
comments: Novel insight that diffusion loss *does* scale with structured language contradicts prior assumptions; prompter training via distillation effectively leverages scaling properties.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Converged diffusion loss scales with structured language in prompts
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; linear scaling with GPG, power-law with ED metric

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structured prompt generation improves generation quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; system matches/surpasses strongest closed-weight baselines

title: QQWorld: Quantile-Quantile Matching for World Model Regularization
task: Improve world model latent distribution via quantile-quantile matching
key_results: QQWorld improves LeWM average planning success rate; achieves better Gaussian alignment and thinner latent tails than EP objective
comments: Addresses tail behavior limitation of Epps-Pulley objective; cross-batch QQ with detached samples is practical for maintaining effective ranking pools.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Quantile-quantile matching maintains corrective gradients better than EP in tails
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; QQWorld achieves thinner tails and improved planning success

title: SAF-OPD: Stable Advantage Fusion for On-Policy Distillation
task: Combine RLVR and on-policy distillation without entropy collapse
key_results: SAF avoids entropy collapse; improves aggregate score by 0.51-2.70% across mathematical reasoning and code generation; outperforms fixed-coefficient GRPO+OPD fusion
comments: Well-diagnosed problem (magnitude and temporal mismatch) with elegant four-stage pipeline; negligible overhead makes practical adoption feasible.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fixed-coefficient fusion of RLVR and OPD advantages triggers entropy collapse
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; magnitude and temporal mismatch identified as root causes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stage-wise control of OPD advantages resolves both mismatches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SAF consistently outperforms fixed-coefficient baseline

title: Fewer Clarifications, Better Code: Benchmarking Cross-Session Personalized Ambiguity Adaptation in Coding Assistants

key_results: CAPA contains 600 coding sessions with 6 ambiguity mechanisms; evaluates 12 LLMs on executable success/first-turn success/turns-to-completion; same-user history improves performance
comments: Novel framing of long-term coding assistance; controlled generation pipeline ensures reproducibility, though 60 user-ambiguity cells remain relatively small.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Previous session history helps resolve recurring personalized ambiguities

title: Enhancing Rubric-based RL via Self-Distillation
task: Address unexplored and suppressed criteria in rubric-based RL via self-distillation
key_results: Over 57% of samples exhibit suppressed criteria; CriPO achieves stronger performance with ~2x fewer optimization steps than rubric-based RL
comments: Insightful diagnosis that scalar reward aggregation loses useful signals; criterion-injection and counterfactual self-teachers elegantly target both failure modes.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Suppressed criteria are prevalent in rubric-based RL and recoverable

title: Evaluation-Verification Reward for Consistent Multi-Reference Image Editing

key_results: EVR provides fine-grained reward signals via evaluation-verification decomposition; RL fine-tuning improves consistency/harmony to match/surpass NanoBanana

key_results: ODEWorld achieves high-quality image reconstruction after long-horizon prediction; supports arbitrary temporal resolution and backward prediction; excels in both video generation and robotic control

key_results: Model achieves robust enhancement across synthetic/real data without clean RGB training data; generalizes across different noise levels

key_results: CSCR outperforms GRPO baseline consistently on long-CoT reasoning; targeted ablations confirm privilege-induced directions unreliable, moderate downweighting most effective

hypotheses.hypothesis: Downweighting highly sensitive tokens improves optimization

key_results: SULAND_v2: 33,771 images, 12,433 bboxes; annotation refinement improves YOLOv8 IID mAP@50 by 14.6-19.6 pp; YOLOv12-Small achieves 0.908 IID, RF-DETR-Large 0.799 OOD mAP@50

key_results: Second Law-based bound limits sustainable temperature difference to small fraction of a degree at inner mitochondrial membrane, ruling out multidegree overheating

title: Computational modeling of motor-driven extension of microtubule bundles in axons reveals a biphasic effect of crosslinker density

key_results: Intermediate crosslinker density maximized bundle elongation; low density caused buckling, high density inhibited displacement; stiffer microtubules tolerated lower crosslinker density

title: Neddylation of NFATc1 and Runx2 regulates osteoclast–osteoblast balance and represents a dual-action therapeutic target for postmenopausal osteoporosis

title: A modelling study of nonlinearity of the cross-shore flow under breaking waves
task: Nonlinear cross-shore flow dynamics under breaking waves via process-based modelling
key_results: Cross-shore velocity skewness and asymmetry depend strongly on breaker type; peak nonlinearities occur near breaking point (spilling) or bar crest (plunging); strong triad coupling and coherent biphase patterns persist within wave boundary layer despite spectral energy decay.
comments: Careful experimental-numerical comparison demonstrates that free-stream-based sediment transport formulations may misrepresent near-bed processes; the boundary-layer filtering and phase-shift mechanisms are physically insightful.

model_io.model: Coupled Boussinesq wave model with 1-DV column model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Breaker type controls peak nonlinearity location in surf zone
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; spilling breakers peak near breaking point, plunging at bar crest

hypotheses.hypothesis: Wave boundary-layer processes generate skewed-asymmetrical velocity evolution toward the bed
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; systematic increase in skewness and decrease in asymmetry with depth

title: A real-time framework for mapping subsea cable burial state using Poincaréspectral coherence of DAS measurements
task: Real-time subsea cable burial state detection via Poincaré spectral coherence of distributed acoustic sensing
key_results: Poincaré spectral coherence method reliably identifies burial coupling transitions; buried segments show smooth coherent spectral behavior; exposed/suspended sections exhibit sharp spatial variability; validated on 5.8 km coastal cable with diver verification.
comments: Simple, unsupervised, computationally efficient method addresses a practical challenge in DAS data interpretation, though sensitivity to seafloor geology and oceanographic noise conditions requires further characterization.

model_io.model: Distributed acoustic sensing on subsea fiber-optic cable
outputs: DAS strain-rate signals across kilometer-scale array

inputs: DAS spectral data in selected frequency bands

hypotheses.hypothesis: Poincaré spectral coherence quantifies acoustic coupling consistency and identifies burial transitions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; buried segments show smooth coherent behavior; exposed/suspended exhibit sharp variability; validated on diver-surveyed 5.8 km cable

title: Robust thermometry-imaging down to sub-micrometer or millisecond-resolution by fluorescence lifetime microscopy allows for additional acquisition of multiple imaging channels
task: Fluorescence lifetime-based thermometry with sub-micrometer spatial and sub-millisecond temporal resolution
key_results: Cy5 excited-state lifetime shows monotonic decline 0–80°C with linear dependence until 39°C; thermometry precision 0.5°C or better; temporal resolution <1 ms for single-pixel measurements; diffraction-limited spatial resolution; simultaneous 4-color live-cell imaging demonstrated.
comments: Robust thermometry approach leveraging lifetime rather than intensity is well-motivated and demonstrates practical multi-color capability, though the limited measurement range (80°C max) and Cy5-dependent characteristics may restrict applicability to certain biological systems.

model_io.model: Fluorescence lifetime microscopy with Cy5 dye

outputs: simultaneous temperature and molecular localization maps

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cy5 excited-state lifetime exhibits temperature-dependent monotonic decline suitable for thermometry
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; linear dependence until 39°C, monoexponential above; ≤0.5°C precision achieved

hypotheses.hypothesis: Far-red Cy5 emission permits simultaneous multi-channel imaging without spectral interference
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 4-color live-cell thermometry demonstrated on standard fluorescence microscopes

title: Shape-induced alignment and voltage-controlled switching in cholesteric droplets for smart film applications
task: Geometric optimization of toroidal director fields in cholesteric droplets for electro-optical switching
key_results: Optimal structure at relative chirality N₀ ≈ 3 and compression ratio δ ≈ 0.2 achieves aligned region a/d ≈ 0.9; droplets with positive dielectric anisotropy show defect-mediated switching with color tuning; negative anisotropy exhibits smooth, reversible reorientation.
comments: Elegant demonstration that geometric compression alone can stabilize toroidal topology without electric field, simplifying device fabrication, though scaling to practical film thicknesses may require further optimization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Droplet flattening preserves toroidal topology and expands uniformly aligned region
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; optimal conditions near N₀ ≈ 3 and δ ≈ 0.2 yield a/d ≥ 0.8

hypotheses.hypothesis: Electric field response differs based on dielectric anisotropy sign
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; positive anisotropy shows defect-mediated switching, negative shows smooth reversible reorientation

title: Advancing boundary-layer physics via Doppler wind LiDAR dynamic-thermodynamic profiling
task: Boundary-layer thermal profiling via Doppler wind LiDAR TKE-budget retrieval
key_results: Wind LiDAR-based retrieval derives virtual potential temperature from TKE-budget buoyancy residuals; field applications resolve stable, convective, and low-level-jet layers with sub-kelvin accuracy; captures turbulence–stability interactions.
comments: Clever inversion technique transforms existing wind LiDAR infrastructure into dynamic-thermodynamic profiler with continuous high-resolution coverage, though sensitivity to TKE measurement errors and applicability in complex terrain deserve further investigation.

model_io.model: Doppler wind LiDAR TKE-budget buoyancy residual inversion

hypotheses.hypothesis: TKE-budget buoyancy residuals can be inverted to retrieve virtual potential temperature without independent thermometer
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; field applications in Shenzhen and Beijing show sub-kelvin accuracy for boundary-layer thermal structure

title: Bow-wake acceleration of ions toward a relativistic regime
task: Ion acceleration via bow-wake trapping in laser-driven wakefields
key_results: Proton energies up to 60 MeV achieved using resorcinol-formaldehyde foam targets; 3D PIC simulations confirm bow-wake acceleration mechanism.
comments: Promising laboratory route toward relativistic ion acceleration, though 60 MeV is modest for cosmic-ray applications and scalability to higher energies with current laser facilities remains uncertain.

model_io.model: Laser-plasma wakefield experiment with dense foam target

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ions are trapped and accelerated by the bow wake formed at the laser front in dense plasma
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PIC simulations and experimental proton energies up to 60 MeV support bow-wake acceleration

title: Simultaneous anomalous reflection and polarization conversion from a tensorial impedance metasurface
task: Anomalous reflection with simultaneous polarization conversion via tensorial impedance metasurface
key_results: Designed metasurfaces achieve simultaneous anomalous reflection and polarization conversion (TE↔TM and TE→CP); tensorial surface impedance approach identifies most physically realizable distributions; experimental validation with patch resonators.
comments: Methodological advance in metasurface design elegantly handles coupled wave transformations, though bandwidth and angle-of-incidence robustness characteristics are not detailed.

model_io.model: Tensorial surface impedance optimization for wave transformation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tensorial impedance distributions can simultaneously achieve anomalous reflection and polarization conversion
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; demonstrated for TM→TE and TM→CP transformations with patch resonators

title: Black yeasts are efficient heterologous hosts for the production of a wide range of fungal polyketides
task: Establish black yeasts as efficient hosts for heterologous fungal polyketide biosynthesis
key_results: Successfully produced 6 fungal polyketides (6-methylsalicylic acid, YWA1, monocillin II, farinosone B, monacolin J) in Exophiala and Knufia with different domain architectures
comments: Demonstrates that genetic tractability and metabolic robustness can be combined in non-model yeasts, expanding the toolkit for polyketide engineering.

model_io.model: Heterologous polyketide expression in black yeasts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Black yeasts (Exophiala, Knufia) are efficient hosts for diverse polyketide production
hypotheses.result: Successfully produced 6 structurally diverse polyketides with different PKS domain architectures

hypotheses.hypothesis: Heterologous expression bypasses native regulation and enables systematic discovery
hypotheses.result: Lab production of polyketides normally requiring difficult environmental conditions achieved
